incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 Billing alert — token-count drift detected in ledger-aggregator. Multiple overage flags triggered for customers in us-west-2. Investigate ASAP.

kate_oncall: oncall here, looking now. which pipeline?

martin: ledger-aggregator -> enrichment stage. Seeing sudden +400k token delta in last 10m vs expected 8k. possible duplicate ingest or window skip.

priya: checking emitter logs, pushing a quick query to verify dup acks. running: `curl internal/emitter/metrics | jq '.tokens_last_15m'`

alex: dashboards show backlog in kafka partition 7 and a stalled commit lag around 300s. suspect replay causing double-count.

sasha: if that's the case we should pause the replays. I can flip the emitter to remain-read-only and enable dedupe mode in the aggregator.

kate_oncall: do that. sasha, pause replays and enable dedupe. mark changes in runbook under Incident 4791234567.

martin: paused kafka consumer group replay: `kafka-consumer-group --reset-offsets --group ledger-replay --to-latest` — offsets moved. switching aggregator to dedupe flag true.

priya: confirmed emitter shows duplicate ack bursts at 01:07UTC, correlates with deploy of emitter v2.5.8. rolling back deploy to v2.5.7 now.

emily_cs: CS heads — customers seeing overage flags in billing UI. No charges applied automatically yet, but flags are alarming. Preparing a proactive note for top-10 affected customers.

alex: quick sanity: run `SELECT count(*) FROM token_events WHERE event_ts > now() - interval '20 minutes' AND dup_mark = true;` -> 387k dup events.

martin: starting short-term mitigation: 1) pause replays (done), 2) rollback emitter (in progress), 3) enable aggregator dedupe (done). Monitoring token delta.

emily_cs: sending initial heads-up to customers with template: "We detected anomalous usage flags affecting display only. We are actively investigating; no billing adjustments applied yet." Want SRE sign-off before send.

kate_oncall: SRE sign-off: go ahead. include timeframe 01:00–01:15UTC and note rollback + dedupe applied. cs to follow up if customers reply.

priya: emitter rollback completed. metrics show duplicate ack rate dropped ~98% within 90s. token-delta now trending down.

martin: backfill plan: we need to replay deduped window for 01:00–01:10 to ensure final counts correct, but hold off until we validate dedupe idempotency. drafting backfill job with filter on event_id.

alex: creating a temporary metric to suppress customer-visible overage flags until backfill completes: `billing.ui.overage_flag_suppressed = true` for affected tenants. will auto-clear after backfill success.

emily_cs: noted — sending update to customers that we're suppressing noisy flags and will confirm final counts by EOD.

sasha: running dry-run of backfill now, dedupe id check passed on sample subset. scheduling full run for +30m to avoid impacting peak.

kate_oncall: handing off incident to priya for 2hr watch. priya, keep this thread updated with token-count snapshots every 10m and escalate to martin if any re-growth.

priya: taking watch. first snapshot: token delta (rolling 15m) = +22k, already down from +400k. will post next in 10.

incident-bot: NOTE: created incident ticket INF-2026-4791234567, pager duty oncall updated.

kate_oncall: thanks team. great quick coordination.

priya: (10m) snapshot: +6k. backfill scheduled in 25m. no new overage flags after suppression toggle.

martin: leaving a short postmortem stub in INF-2026-4791234567: root cause suspected emitter duplicate acks after v2.5.8 rollout; mitigations: rollback, dedupe, suppress flags, backfill. will expand after wrap.

emily_cs: will prepare customer follow-up copy once counts confirmed.

kate_oncall: closing active paging for now, handoff acknowledged. will reopen if delta increases. :white_check_mark:
